title: 大貝爾特東橋
summary: 大貝爾特東橋以 1,624 m 主跨與 254 m 混凝土橋塔跨越丹麥大貝爾特海峽東航道，1998 年通車。本課從航道船舶撞擊模擬如何決定跨徑出發，說明封閉鋼箱梁的渦流鎖定與導流板、18,648 根鋼絲的空中紡線主纜、壓重錨碇、預製沉箱拖航與橋面吊裝，再到 2015 年完成的主纜除濕改造、營運中的船舶風險管理與 200 年壽命評估。
summaryEn: The Great Belt East Bridge crosses the East Channel of Denmark's Great Belt with a 1,624 m main span and 254 m concrete pylons, opening in 1998. The course starts from how ship-collision simulations set the span, then explains vortex lock-in and guide vanes on the closed steel box girder, air-spun cables of 18,648 wires, ballasted anchor blocks, towed caissons and deck lifting, and finally the cable dehumidification retrofit completed in 2015, ship-risk management in operation and the assessment of a 200-year service life.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：比較兩種主纜防蝕策略對 3 km 主纜的影響。主纜鋼絲 18,648 根、直徑 5.38 mm，鋼絲總面積 A ≈ 423,900 mm²。假設恆載與活載下每纜最大張力 T = 260 MN，鋼絲強度 1,570 MPa，破斷力 = 0.4239×1,570 ≈ 666 MN，安全係數 = 666/260 ≈ 2.56。若腐蝕使有效鋼絲面積損失 5%，係數降為 2.56×0.95 ≈ 2.43；損失 10% 時約 2.30。若規定最低安全係數 2.2，可容許的面積損失約 1 − 2.2/2.56 ≈ 14%。除濕把纜內相對濕度維持在腐蝕門檻以下，目的是讓面積損失長期接近零，而不是等損失接近 14% 才介入。數值為教學假設，不代表大貝爾特東橋的設計或檢測結果。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: compare two corrosion-protection strategies for a 3 km cable. The cable has 18,648 wires of 5.38 mm, a total steel area A ≈ 423,900 mm². Assume a maximum tension per cable under dead and live load of T = 260 MN and wire strength 1,570 MPa: breaking force = 0.4239×1,570 ≈ 666 MN and the safety factor = 666/260 ≈ 2.56. If corrosion removes 5% of the effective wire area the factor falls to 2.56×0.95 ≈ 2.43; at 10% it is about 2.30. With a minimum required factor of 2.2 the tolerable area loss is about 1 − 2.2/2.56 ≈ 14%. Dehumidification keeps internal humidity below the corrosion threshold so that area loss stays near zero for the long term, rather than waiting until loss approaches 14% before acting. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design or inspection results of the Great Belt East Bridge.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「以船舶撞擊風險決定主跨」與「封閉箱梁的渦流鎖定」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Setting the main span from ship-collision risk" and "Vortex lock-in of the closed box girder": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 以船舶撞擊風險決定主跨：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Setting the main span from ship-collision risk: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「東航道船舶撞擊」如何影響大貝爾特東橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “East Channel ship impact” governs force, deformation or durability in “Great Belt East Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 東航道水深約 60 m，每年約 25,000 艘船通過大貝爾特橋梁，其中約 95% 從東橋下方通過。營運單位說明，主跨 1,624 m 是以船舶操縱模擬決定，目的是把撞擊機率降到可接受的水準；橋塔、錨碇與最靠近航道的橋墩則設計成即使被撞也不致造成關鍵性破壞。懸索橋把主要構件放在航道兩側，跨徑越大，塔與錨碇離航道中心越遠，偏航船舶撞上的幾何機率越小，但主纜、塔高與錨碇規模也隨之增加。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「東航道船舶撞擊」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The East Channel is about 60 m deep, and about 25,000 ships a year pass the Great Belt bridges, about 95% of them under the East Bridge. The operator explains that the 1,624 m main span was set by ship-manoeuvring simulations to bring collision probability down to an acceptable level, while pylons, anchor blocks and the piers nearest the channel were designed so that an impact would not cause critical damage. A suspension bridge keeps its main supports on either side of the channel; the larger the span, the farther pylons and anchorages sit from the channel centreline and the lower the geometric chance that an errant ship hits them, but cables, pylon height and anchorage size grow with it. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “East Channel ship impact” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：撞擊動能 E = ½·(1+c_H)·m·v²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Impact energy E = ½·(1+c_H)·m·v².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「大型懸索橋的橋塔很粗，船撞上去也不會有問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Large suspension-bridge pylons are so massive that a ship strike cannot matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「東航道船舶撞擊」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “East Channel ship impact”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「以船舶撞擊風險決定主跨」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Setting the main span from ship-collision risk" is correct?
options: 大型懸索橋的橋塔很粗，船撞上去也不會有問題。
東航道水深約 60 m，每年約 25,000 艘船通過大貝爾特橋梁，其中約 95% 從東橋下方通過。
能抵抗顫振的流線形箱梁就不會有任何風致振動。

quiz.explanationEn: The East Channel is about 60 m deep, and about 25,000 ships a year pass the Great Belt bridges, about 95% of them under the East Bridge. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 以船舶撞擊風險決定主跨：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Setting the main span from ship-collision risk: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「東航道船舶撞擊」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “East Channel ship impact” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：撞擊動能 E = ½·(1+c_H)·m·v²。取排水量 60,000 t、附加水質量係數 c_H = 0.1、速度 6 m/s（約 12 節）：E = 0.5×1.1×60×10⁶×6² ≈ 1,188 MJ。速度降為 4 m/s 時 E 只剩約 528 MJ，可見航速管制對撞擊能量的影響是平方關係。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Impact energy E = ½·(1+c_H)·m·v². For a 60,000 t displacement, added-water coefficient c_H = 0.1 and 6 m/s (about 12 knots): E = 0.5×1.1×60×10⁶×6² ≈ 1,188 MJ. At 4 m/s E falls to about 528 MJ, showing that speed control affects impact energy quadratically. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以航行模擬器與歷史航跡資料建立船型、航速與偏航分布，計算各構件的年撞擊頻率並與風險準則比較；對可能被撞的塔、錨碇與橋墩做撞擊力與變形分析，必要時以人工島或防撞結構保護，並由海事主管機關審查航道配置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use navigation simulators and historical track data to build ship-type, speed and aberrancy distributions, compute annual impact frequency for each element against the risk criterion, analyse impact forces and deformation on pylons, anchorages and piers that could be hit, protect them with islands or fenders where needed, and have the maritime authority review the channel layout.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 撞擊動能 E = ½·(1+c_H)·m·v²。取排水量 60,000 t、附加水質量係數 c_H = 0.1、速度 6 m/s（約 12 節）：E = 0.5×1.1×60×10⁶×6² ≈ 1,188 MJ。速度降為 4 m/s 時 E 只剩約 528 MJ，可見航速管制對撞擊能量的影響是平方關係。數值為教學假設。

At 4 m/s E falls to about 528 MJ, showing that speed control affects impact energy quadratically. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「以船舶撞擊風險決定主跨」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Setting the main span from ship-collision risk", which statement holds?
options: 錨碇只要夠重就好，浮力與主纜上拔分量可以忽略。
鋼箱梁節段吊上去就立即焊接，可以縮短工期而不影響結構。
撞擊動能 E = ½·(1+c_H)·m·v²。
optionsEn: An anchor block just has to be heavy; buoyancy and cable uplift can be ignored.
Welding each box segment as soon as it is lifted saves time without affecting the structure.
Impact energy E = ½·(1+c_H)·m·v².
quiz.explanation: 撞擊動能 E = ½·(1+c_H)·m·v²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Impact energy E = ½·(1+c_H)·m·v². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 以船舶撞擊風險決定主跨：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Setting the main span from ship-collision risk: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「東航道船舶撞擊」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “East Channel ship impact” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以航行模擬器與歷史航跡資料建立船型、航速與偏航分布，計算各構件的年撞擊頻率並與風險準則比較；對可能被撞的塔、錨碇與橋墩做撞擊力與變形分析，必要時以人工島或防撞結構保護，並由海事主管機關審查航道配置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use navigation simulators and historical track data to build ship-type, speed and aberrancy distributions, compute annual impact frequency for each element against the risk criterion, analyse impact forces and deformation on pylons, anchorages and piers that could be hit, protect them with islands or fenders where needed, and have the maritime authority review the channel layout. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計基準書應明列設計船型、撞擊速度、年撞擊頻率準則與各構件的撞擊等級，並與航道管理、船舶監控系統的營運規則一起交接；船隊規模變化時要重新評估。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The design basis must state design vessels, impact speeds, the annual-frequency criterion and the impact class of each element, handed over together with channel-management and ship-monitoring rules, and re-assessed when the fleet changes.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若跨徑或防護只依當時船型設計，未考慮未來更大的船舶，撞擊能量可能超出構件容量；2001 年一艘貨輪曾駛向東橋錨碇，橋梁封閉約 10 分鐘，直到船被引開，顯示偏航事件確實會發生。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing span or protection only for the fleet of the day, without larger future ships, can let impact energy exceed element capacity; in 2001 a bulk carrier headed toward an East Bridge anchor block and the bridge closed for about 10 minutes until the ship was diverted, showing that aberrant passages do happen. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以航行模擬器與歷史航跡資料建立船型、航速與偏航分布，計算各構件的年撞擊頻率並與風險準則比較；對可能被撞的塔、錨碇與橋墩做撞擊力與變形分析，必要時以人工島或防撞結構保護，並由海事主管機關審查航道配置。
knowledge.textEn: Use navigation simulators and historical track data to build ship-type, speed and aberrancy distributions, compute annual impact frequency for each element against the risk criterion, analyse impact forces and deformation on pylons, anchorages and piers that could be hit, protect them with islands or fenders where needed, and have the maritime authority review the channel layout.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計基準書應明列設計船型、撞擊速度、年撞擊頻率準則與各構件的撞擊等級，並與航道管理、船舶監控系統的營運規則一起交接；船隊規模變化時要重新評估。
knowledge.textEn: The design basis must state design vessels, impact speeds, the annual-frequency criterion and the impact class of each element, handed over together with channel-management and ship-monitoring rules, and re-assessed when the fleet changes.

quiz.question: 要驗證「以船舶撞擊風險決定主跨」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Setting the main span from ship-collision risk"?
options: 以航行模擬器與歷史航跡資料建立船型、航速與偏航分布，計算各構件的年撞擊頻率並與風險準則比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
主纜沒有生鏽就不需要除濕，等出現鏽蝕再處理比較經濟。
optionsEn: Use navigation simulators and historical track data to build ship-type, speed and aberrancy distributions, compute annual impact frequency for each element against the risk criterion, analyse impact forces and deformation on pylons, anchorages and piers that could be hit, protect them with islands or fenders where needed, and have the maritime authority review the channel layout.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If a cable shows no rust there is no need to dehumidify; it is cheaper to wait for corrosion.
quiz.explanation: 以航行模擬器與歷史航跡資料建立船型、航速與偏航分布，計算各構件的年撞擊頻率並與風險準則比較；對可能被撞的塔、錨碇與橋墩做撞擊力與變形分析，必要時以人工島或防撞結構保護，並由海事主管機關審查航道配置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use navigation simulators and historical track data to build ship-type, speed and aberrancy distributions, compute annual impact frequency for each element against the risk criterion, analyse impact forces and deformation on pylons, anchorages and piers that could be hit, protect them with islands or fenders where needed, and have the maritime authority review the channel layout. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 以船舶撞擊風險決定主跨：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Setting the main span from ship-collision risk: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「東航道船舶撞擊」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “East Channel ship impact” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若跨徑或防護只依當時船型設計，未考慮未來更大的船舶，撞擊能量可能超出構件容量；2001 年一艘貨輪曾駛向東橋錨碇，橋梁封閉約 10 分鐘，直到船被引開，顯示偏航事件確實會發生。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Designing span or protection only for the fleet of the day, without larger future ships, can let impact energy exceed element capacity; in 2001 a bulk carrier headed toward an East Bridge anchor block and the bridge closed for about 10 minutes until the ship was diverted, showing that aberrant passages do happen. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：懸索橋把主要構件放在航道兩側，跨徑越大，塔與錨碇離航道中心越遠，偏航船舶撞上的幾何機率越小，但主纜、塔高與錨碇規模也隨之增加。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A suspension bridge keeps its main supports on either side of the channel; the larger the span, the farther pylons and anchorages sit from the channel centreline and the lower the geometric chance that an errant ship hits them, but cables, pylon height and anchorage size grow with it.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「大型懸索橋的橋塔很粗，船撞上去也不會有問題。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Large suspension-bridge pylons are so massive that a ship strike cannot matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 封閉箱梁的渦流鎖定：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Vortex lock-in of the closed box girder: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「31 m 封閉鋼箱梁」如何影響大貝爾特東橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “31 m closed steel box” governs force, deformation or durability in “Great Belt East Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 東橋橋面為寬約 31 m 的流線形封閉鋼箱梁，對顫振有良好的扭轉勁度與氣動外形，但在低風速時，箱梁下緣交替脫落的渦流可能與低階豎彎模態的頻率一致，形成渦流鎖定：振幅在一段窄風速範圍內持續存在，風速再提高反而消失。這類振動不會發散，卻讓用路人感到明顯的上下起伏，並增加疲勞循環。公開文獻記載東橋的主要風致問題是渦致振動，控制方法為在箱梁下方加裝導流板。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「31 m 封閉鋼箱梁」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The East Bridge deck is a streamlined closed steel box about 31 m wide, with good torsional stiffness and shape against flutter, but at low wind speeds vortices shed alternately from the lower edges of the box can match the frequency of a low vertical bending mode and lock in: the amplitude persists over a narrow band of wind speeds and disappears as the wind strengthens. Such vibration does not diverge, but drivers feel a distinct heaving and fatigue cycles accumulate. Published literature lists vortex-induced vibration as the main wind problem of the East Bridge, controlled by guide vanes fitted beneath the box. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “31 m closed steel box” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：鎖定風速 U_cr = f·D/St。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Lock-in wind speed U_cr = f·D/St. With girder depth D = 4 m and St = 0.11 based on depth: a vertical mode at f = 0.13 Hz gives U_cr = 0.13×4/0.11 ≈ 4.7 m/s, and f = 0.20 Hz gives about 7.3 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「能抵抗顫振的流線形箱梁就不會有任何風致振動。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A streamlined box that resists flutter cannot have any wind-induced vibration." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「31 m 封閉鋼箱梁」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 封閉箱梁的渦流鎖定：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Vortex lock-in of the closed box girder: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「31 m 封閉鋼箱梁」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “31 m closed steel box” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：鎖定風速 U_cr = f·D/St。取梁深 D = 4 m、以梁深計 St = 0.11：豎彎模態 f = 0.13 Hz 時 U_cr = 0.13×4/0.11 ≈ 4.7 m/s；f = 0.20 Hz 時約 7.3 m/s。可見長跨箱梁的多個低階模態都可能在每天常見的低風速下被激發。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Lock-in wind speed U_cr = f·D/St. With girder depth D = 4 m and St = 0.11 based on depth: a vertical mode at f = 0.13 Hz gives U_cr = 0.13×4/0.11 ≈ 4.7 m/s, and f = 0.20 Hz gives about 7.3 m/s. Several low modes of a long box girder can therefore be excited at everyday low wind speeds. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以斷面模型在低紊流中逐級提高風速，記錄振幅—風速曲線找出鎖定範圍，並以不同結構阻尼重複試驗；實橋以加速度計與風速計長期監測，按風速、風向分類統計振幅，確認鎖定範圍與試驗一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Raise wind speed step by step on a section model in low turbulence, recording amplitude against wind speed to find lock-in bands, repeating with different structural damping; on the bridge monitor accelerations and wind long term, sorting amplitude by wind speed and direction to confirm the lock-in bands match the tests.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 封閉箱梁的渦流鎖定：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Vortex lock-in of the closed box girder: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「31 m 封閉鋼箱梁」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “31 m closed steel box” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以斷面模型在低紊流中逐級提高風速，記錄振幅—風速曲線找出鎖定範圍，並以不同結構阻尼重複試驗；實橋以加速度計與風速計長期監測，按風速、風向分類統計振幅，確認鎖定範圍與試驗一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Raise wind speed step by step on a section model in low turbulence, recording amplitude against wind speed to find lock-in bands, repeating with different structural damping; on the bridge monitor accelerations and wind long term, sorting amplitude by wind speed and direction to confirm the lock-in bands match the tests. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：抗風設計報告應分開列出顫振、抖振與渦振三種檢核，以及渦振的使用性準則；斷面細部（欄杆、檢修車軌道、排水）在試驗後若有變更，須重新評估渦振。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The wind design report must list flutter, buffeting and vortex-shedding checks separately, with serviceability criteria for vortex shedding; any change to section details (railings, gantry rails, drainage) after testing requires a new vortex assessment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只檢核顫振而忽略渦振，橋梁可能在通車前後的平常天氣就出現明顯起伏，必須事後加裝導流板或阻尼器；未處理的渦振累積大量應力循環，加速吊索端部與鋼橋面焊道疲勞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Checking flutter while ignoring vortex shedding can leave a bridge heaving noticeably in ordinary weather around opening, forcing guide vanes or dampers to be retrofitted; untreated vortex vibration piles up stress cycles that accelerate fatigue at hanger ends and steel-deck welds. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 空中紡線主纜的斷面組成：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Make-up of the air-spun main cables: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「18,648 根 5.38 mm 鋼絲」如何影響大貝爾特東橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “18,648 wires of 5.38 mm” governs force, deformation or durability in “Great Belt East Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 東橋兩條主纜各長約 3 km、直徑約 83 cm，每條含 18,648 根 5.38 mm 鋼絲，在錨碇底部分成 37 束錨定。這種由數百根鋼絲組成一束、再以多束組成主纜的構造，是空中紡線法的典型：紡線輪在貓道上方來回牽引單根鋼絲，逐束累積到設計數量，再把各束壓擠成圓形，外層以鋼線纏繞並做防護。與預製索股相比，空中紡線的鋼絲連續、束數少，錨碇端的錨固點也較少，但現場作業時間長且受風影響。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「18,648 根 5.38 mm 鋼絲」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each of the East Bridge's two main cables is about 3 km long and 83 cm in diameter, containing 18,648 wires of 5.38 mm and split into 37 bundles anchored at the base of each anchor block. Building a cable from bundles of several hundred wires is typical of aerial spinning: spinning wheels carry individual wires back and forth above the catwalk, accumulating each bundle to its design count, after which the bundles are compacted into a circle, wrapped with steel wire and protected. Compared with prefabricated strands, aerial spinning gives continuous wires and fewer, larger bundles with fewer anchorage points, but longer site work that is sensitive to wind. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “18,648 wires of 5.38 mm” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Wires per bundle = 18,648/37 = 504.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「主纜直徑越粗代表鋼絲越多，空隙率不影響性能。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A fatter cable just means more wire; void ratio does not affect performance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「18,648 根 5.38 mm 鋼絲」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “18,648 wires of 5.38 mm”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 空中紡線主纜的斷面組成：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Make-up of the air-spun main cables: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「18,648 根 5.38 mm 鋼絲」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “18,648 wires of 5.38 mm” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：每束鋼絲數 = 18,648/37 = 504 根。單絲面積 π/4×5.38² = 22.73 mm²，鋼絲總面積 A = 18,648×22.73 ≈ 423,900 mm²；主纜毛面積 π/4×0.83² = 0.541 m²，空隙率 = 1 − 0.424/0.541 ≈ 22%；鋼絲自重 0.424×7,850 ≈ 3.33 t/m。以上由公開數據推算。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Wires per bundle = 18,648/37 = 504. Wire area π/4×5.38² = 22.73 mm², total steel area A = 18,648×22.73 ≈ 423,900 mm²; gross cable area π/4×0.83² = 0.541 m², so void ratio = 1 − 0.424/0.541 ≈ 22%; wire self-weight 0.424×7,850 ≈ 3.33 t/m. Derived from published figures. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：紡線期間每束完成時核對鋼絲數、束長與垂度，並以溫度修正後的測量確保各束一致；壓擠後沿全長量測主纜周長與直徑，換算空隙率並與設計值比較；纏絲張力與搭接、防護層厚度也逐段驗收。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During spinning check wire count, bundle length and sag for each completed bundle, using temperature-corrected surveys to keep bundles consistent; after compaction measure cable circumference and diameter along the length, convert to void ratio and compare with design; accept wrapping tension, laps and protection thickness section by section.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 紡線期間每束完成時核對鋼絲數、束長與垂度，並以溫度修正後的測量確保各束一致；壓擠後沿全長量測主纜周長與直徑，換算空隙率並與設計值比較；纏絲張力與搭接、防護層厚度也逐段驗收。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During spinning check wire count, bundle length and sag for each completed bundle, using temperature-corrected surveys to keep bundles consistent; after compaction measure cable circumference and diameter along the length, convert to void ratio and compare with design; accept wrapping tension, laps and protection thickness section by section. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含每束鋼絲數、束的錨固位置圖、壓擠後的直徑紀錄與纏絲資料，作為日後開纜檢查、斷絲統計與強度評估的基礎。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover documents should include wire count per bundle, a map of bundle anchorage positions, post-compaction diameter records and wrapping data as the basis for later cable openings, broken-wire counts and strength evaluation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若某束鋼絲在紡線時張力不均，壓擠後部分鋼絲鬆弛、部分過載；壓擠不足使空隙率偏高，水分更容易積聚，索夾也較難夾緊而發生滑移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Uneven wire tension within a bundle during spinning leaves some wires slack and others overloaded after compaction; under-compaction leaves a high void ratio where moisture collects more easily, and cable bands grip less well and may slip. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「18,648 根 5.38 mm 鋼絲」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “18,648 wires of 5.38 mm” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若某束鋼絲在紡線時張力不均，壓擠後部分鋼絲鬆弛、部分過載；壓擠不足使空隙率偏高，水分更容易積聚，索夾也較難夾緊而發生滑移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Uneven wire tension within a bundle during spinning leaves some wires slack and others overloaded after compaction; under-compaction leaves a high void ratio where moisture collects more easily, and cable bands grip less well and may slip. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：與預製索股相比，空中紡線的鋼絲連續、束數少，錨碇端的錨固點也較少，但現場作業時間長且受風影響。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compared with prefabricated strands, aerial spinning gives continuous wires and fewer, larger bundles with fewer anchorage points, but longer site work that is sensitive to wind.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「主纜直徑越粗代表鋼絲越多，空隙率不影響性能。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A fatter cable just means more wire; void ratio does not affect performance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 重力式錨碇的抗滑與壓重：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Sliding resistance and ballast of gravity anchor blocks: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「325,000 t 壓重錨碇」如何影響大貝爾特東橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “325,000 t ballasted anchor block” governs force, deformation or durability in “Great Belt East Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 主纜張力最終要由錨碇以重量與基底摩擦抵抗。東橋每座錨碇高約 63 m，連同砂與鐵礦砂壓重總重約 325,000 t，主纜在錨碇內分成 37 束錨定在底部。錨碇位於海中，部分體積受浮力，主纜張力又有向上的分量，兩者都減少可提供摩擦的有效重量。使用高密度的鐵礦砂作為壓重，可以在有限體積內提高重量，同時讓錨碇也承擔船舶撞擊防護的角色。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「325,000 t 壓重錨碇」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Main-cable tension is ultimately resisted by the anchor blocks through weight and base friction. Each East Bridge anchor block is about 63 m high and weighs about 325,000 t including sand and iron-ore ballast, with each cable split into 37 bundles anchored at the base. Sitting in the sea, the blocks lose part of their weight to buoyancy, and the cable tension has an upward component; both reduce the effective weight available for friction. Dense iron-ore ballast raises weight within a limited volume, and the blocks also act as ship-impact protection. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “325,000 t ballasted anchor block” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：抗滑安全係數 FS = μ·(W − U − T·sinθ)/(T·cosθ)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Sliding safety factor FS = μ·(W − U − T·sinθ)/(T·cosθ).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「錨碇只要夠重就好，浮力與主纜上拔分量可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An anchor block just has to be heavy; buoyancy and cable uplift can be ignored." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「325,000 t 壓重錨碇」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 重力式錨碇的抗滑與壓重：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sliding resistance and ballast of gravity anchor blocks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「325,000 t 壓重錨碇」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “325,000 t ballasted anchor block” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：抗滑安全係數 FS = μ·(W − U − T·sinθ)/(T·cosθ)。取 W = 325,000 t×9.81 ≈ 3,188 MN、浮力 U ≈ 603 MN、兩纜合力 T = 520 MN、θ = 20°、μ = 0.5：水平分量 489 MN、上拔 178 MN，抵抗力 0.5×(3,188 − 603 − 178) ≈ 1,204 MN，FS ≈ 2.46。除重量外為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Sliding safety factor FS = μ·(W − U − T·sinθ)/(T·cosθ). With W = 325,000 t×9.81 ≈ 3,188 MN, buoyancy U ≈ 603 MN, combined cable force T = 520 MN, θ = 20° and μ = 0.5: horizontal 489 MN, uplift 178 MN, resistance 0.5×(3,188 − 603 − 178) ≈ 1,204 MN and FS ≈ 2.46. All but the weight are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：施工中逐層記錄混凝土與壓重材料的體積與密度，計算實際重量與重心並與設計比較；基底承載與摩擦參數以地質鑽探與試驗確認；營運期以精密測量監測錨碇的水平位移、沉陷與傾斜，與溫度及纜力變化一起判讀。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During construction record the volume and density of concrete and ballast layer by layer, computing actual weight and centre of gravity against design; confirm base bearing and friction parameters by boreholes and tests; in service monitor horizontal movement, settlement and tilt of the anchor blocks by precise survey, interpreted together with temperature and cable-force changes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.titleEn: Sliding resistance and ballast of gravity anchor blocks: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「325,000 t 壓重錨碇」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 施工中逐層記錄混凝土與壓重材料的體積與密度，計算實際重量與重心並與設計比較；基底承載與摩擦參數以地質鑽探與試驗確認；營運期以精密測量監測錨碇的水平位移、沉陷與傾斜，與溫度及纜力變化一起判讀。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：壓重材料的來源、密度試驗頻率與填充驗收應列為停留點；錨碇監測點與基準點須在施工初期建立並長期保存，任何錨碇周邊的疏浚或填海都要先評估對抗滑的影響。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Ballast source, density testing frequency and fill acceptance should be hold points; anchor-block survey points and benchmarks must be set early and kept for the long term, and any dredging or reclamation near the blocks must first be assessed for its effect on sliding resistance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若壓重材料密度低於假設或填充不足，錨碇重量不足，長期可能出現微量滑移，主纜垂度隨之增加；基底軟弱層未被發現時，則可能在偏心荷重下產生不均勻沉陷與傾斜。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ballast lighter than assumed or incompletely filled leaves the block underweight and can allow slow creep that increases cable sag; an undetected weak layer at the base can cause uneven settlement and tilt under eccentric load. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 沉箱拖航與橋塔爬升模板：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Caisson towing and pylon climbing formwork: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「32,000 t 塔基沉箱」如何影響大貝爾特東橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “32,000 t pylon caissons” governs force, deformation or durability in “Great Belt East Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 東橋兩座橋塔的基礎沉箱各重約 32,000 t，在卡倫堡預鑄，再拖航約 70 km 到橋址沉放；其上的塔柱則在現場以爬升模板每次 4 m 分段澆置，直到 254 m 高。把基礎移到岸上預製，可在受控環境下完成大量混凝土並縮短海上作業；塔柱以爬模施工則把每一段的鋼筋、預埋件與幾何量測變成重複的循環，垂直度與斷面尺寸靠每一節的測量與修正累積控制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「32,000 t 塔基沉箱」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each of the two East Bridge pylon caissons weighs about 32,000 t; they were precast in Kalundborg and towed about 70 km to the site, and the pylon legs above were cast on site in 4 m lifts with climbing formwork up to 254 m. Moving foundations ashore lets large volumes of concrete be cast under controlled conditions and shortens marine work; climbing formwork turns each lift's reinforcement, embedded items and geometry survey into a repeated cycle, with verticality and section size controlled by surveying and correcting every lift. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “32,000 t pylon caissons” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：塔柱約 250 m、每節 4 m，需約 250/4 ≈ 63 節；若每節循環 4 天，單一塔柱約需 250 天。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A pylon leg of about 250 m in 4 m lifts needs about 250/4 ≈ 63 lifts; at 4 days per cycle a leg takes about 250 days.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「塔柱只要每節都垂直，整座塔就一定垂直。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If every lift is vertical, the whole pylon is automatically vertical." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 沉箱拖航與橋塔爬升模板：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Caisson towing and pylon climbing formwork: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「32,000 t 塔基沉箱」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “32,000 t pylon caissons” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：塔柱約 250 m、每節 4 m，需約 250/4 ≈ 63 節；若每節循環 4 天，單一塔柱約需 250 天。拖航 70 km、拖速約 2 節（3.7 km/h），約需 70/3.7 ≈ 19 h，因此需要至少一天的可靠氣象窗口。循環天數與拖速為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A pylon leg of about 250 m in 4 m lifts needs about 250/4 ≈ 63 lifts; at 4 days per cycle a leg takes about 250 days. Towing 70 km at about 2 knots (3.7 km/h) takes about 70/3.7 ≈ 19 h, so a reliable weather window of at least a day is needed. Cycle time and tow speed are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每節澆置前以全站儀與 GNSS 量測模板位置，並以溫度與日照修正塔柱傾斜；混凝土以試體與溫度計監測強度發展後才爬升；拖航前由海事檢驗確認穩性與氣象，沉放後量測沉箱位置與高程作為塔柱放樣的基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before each lift survey formwork position by total station and GNSS, correcting pylon lean for temperature and sun; climb only after cubes and thermocouples confirm strength gain; before towing a marine surveyor confirms stability and weather, and after placement the caisson position and level become the setting-out datum for the legs.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 塔柱約 250 m、每節 4 m，需約 250/4 ≈ 63 節；若每節循環 4 天，單一塔柱約需 250 天。拖航 70 km、拖速約 2 節（3.7 km/h），約需 70/3.7 ≈ 19 h，因此需要至少一天的可靠氣象窗口。循環天數與拖速為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A pylon leg of about 250 m in 4 m lifts needs about 250/4 ≈ 63 lifts; at 4 days per cycle a leg takes about 250 days. Towing 70 km at about 2 knots (3.7 km/h) takes about 70/3.7 ≈ 19 h, so a reliable weather window of at least a day is needed. Cycle time and tow speed are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「沉箱拖航與橋塔爬升模板」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Caisson towing and pylon climbing formwork", which statement holds?
options: 塔柱約 250 m、每節 4 m，需約 250/4 ≈ 63 節；若每節循環 4 天，單一塔柱約需 250 天。
主纜沒有生鏽就不需要除濕，等出現鏽蝕再處理比較經濟。
混凝土橋塔不會生鏽，延壽只需處理鋼主纜與鋼箱梁。
optionsEn: A pylon leg of about 250 m in 4 m lifts needs about 250/4 ≈ 63 lifts; at 4 days per cycle a leg takes about 250 days.
If a cable shows no rust there is no need to dehumidify; it is cheaper to wait for corrosion.
Concrete pylons cannot rust, so life extension only concerns the steel cables and box girder.

steps.title: 沉箱拖航與橋塔爬升模板：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Caisson towing and pylon climbing formwork: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「32,000 t 塔基沉箱」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “32,000 t pylon caissons” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每節澆置前以全站儀與 GNSS 量測模板位置，並以溫度與日照修正塔柱傾斜；混凝土以試體與溫度計監測強度發展後才爬升；拖航前由海事檢驗確認穩性與氣象，沉放後量測沉箱位置與高程作為塔柱放樣的基準。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before each lift survey formwork position by total station and GNSS, correcting pylon lean for temperature and sun; climb only after cubes and thermocouples confirm strength gain; before towing a marine surveyor confirms stability and weather, and after placement the caisson position and level become the setting-out datum for the legs. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：爬模施工計畫要規定量測時段、溫度修正方法、爬升前最低混凝土強度與錨固檢查，作為每一節的停留點，由現場工程師與模板供應商共同簽認後才可爬升。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The climbing-form plan must set survey windows, temperature-correction method, minimum concrete strength before climbing and anchor checks as a hold point for every lift, signed jointly by the site engineer and the formwork supplier before climbing.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：日照造成塔柱單側受熱彎曲，若在午後量測放樣，誤差會逐節累積成明顯的傾斜；混凝土強度不足時爬升，模板錨固點可能拉脫，造成高空墜落與結構損傷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sun heating one face bends the pylon, so setting out in the afternoon accumulates error lift by lift into a visible lean; climbing before the concrete is strong enough can pull out formwork anchors, causing falls from height and structural damage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 爬模施工計畫要規定量測時段、溫度修正方法、爬升前最低混凝土強度與錨固檢查，作為每一節的停留點，由現場工程師與模板供應商共同簽認後才可爬升。

quiz.question: 要驗證「沉箱拖航與橋塔爬升模板」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 沉箱拖航與橋塔爬升模板：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「32,000 t 塔基沉箱」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 日照造成塔柱單側受熱彎曲，若在午後量測放樣，誤差會逐節累積成明顯的傾斜；混凝土強度不足時爬升，模板錨固點可能拉脫，造成高空墜落與結構損傷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sun heating one face bends the pylon, so setting out in the afternoon accumulates error lift by lift into a visible lean; climbing before the concrete is strong enough can pull out formwork anchors, causing falls from height and structural damage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把基礎移到岸上預製，可在受控環境下完成大量混凝土並縮短海上作業；塔柱以爬模施工則把每一段的鋼筋、預埋件與幾何量測變成重複的循環，垂直度與斷面尺寸靠每一節的測量與修正累積控制。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Moving foundations ashore lets large volumes of concrete be cast under controlled conditions and shortens marine work; climbing formwork turns each lift's reinforcement, embedded items and geometry survey into a repeated cycle, with verticality and section size controlled by surveying and correcting every lift.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「塔柱只要每節都垂直，整座塔就一定垂直。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If every lift is vertical, the whole pylon is automatically vertical." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 鋼箱梁吊裝與臨時鉸接：機制與傳力路徑

steps.objective: 說明「橋面節段臨時鉸接」如何影響大貝爾特東橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Temporary deck-segment hinges” governs force, deformation or durability in “Great Belt East Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 公開資料記載東橋鋼箱梁由法國 Alsthom Sdem 製造組裝，荷蘭 Ballast Nedam 以浮吊吊放節段。懸索橋橋面在架設初期只有部分節段掛上吊索，主纜仍在變形，相鄰節段之間的角度與完工狀態差異很大。因此節段之間通常先以頂部臨時鉸接，底部保持開口，讓節段隨主纜幾何自由轉動；待大部分節段就位、主纜接近完工線形，開口逐漸閉合後才焊接成連續梁。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「橋面節段臨時鉸接」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Public records show the East Bridge box sections were fabricated and assembled by Alsthom Sdem of France, and Ballast Nedam of the Netherlands placed them with a floating crane. Early in erection only some segments hang from the hangers and the cables are still deforming, so the angle between neighbouring segments differs greatly from the final state. Segments are therefore usually pinned at the top with the bottom left open, so they rotate freely with the cable geometry; only when most segments are in place and the cable nears its final profile do the gaps close and get welded into a continuous girder. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Temporary deck-segment hinges” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以拋物線曲率 κ = 8f/l² 估算局部轉角。

steps.title: 鋼箱梁吊裝與臨時鉸接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Box-girder lifting and temporary hinges: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「橋面節段臨時鉸接」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Temporary deck-segment hinges” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以拋物線曲率 κ = 8f/l² 估算局部轉角。取 l = 1,624 m、f = l/9 ≈ 180.4 m：κ ≈ 5.47×10⁻⁴ 1/m；節段長 48 m 時相鄰轉角 θ = 48×κ ≈ 0.026 rad，梁深 4 m 時底部開口約 4×0.026 ≈ 0.105 m（約 105 mm）。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Estimate local rotation from parabolic curvature κ = 8f/l². With l = 1,624 m and f = l/9 ≈ 180.4 m: κ ≈ 5.47×10⁻⁴ 1/m; for 48 m segments the angle between neighbours is θ = 48×κ ≈ 0.026 rad, and with a 4 m deep girder the bottom gap is about 4×0.026 ≈ 0.105 m (about 105 mm). Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每吊裝一個節段後量測各接縫上下開口、節段高程與主纜垂度，與施工階段分析逐步比較；焊接封閉前確認開口已在容許範圍並記錄溫度，焊後以超音波檢測接縫並複測線形。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After each lift measure top and bottom gaps at every joint, segment levels and cable sag against the stage analysis; before welding confirm gaps are within tolerance and record temperature, then test the welds ultrasonically and re-survey the profile.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「橋面節段臨時鉸接」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Temporary deck-segment hinges” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每吊裝一個節段後量測各接縫上下開口、節段高程與主纜垂度，與施工階段分析逐步比較；焊接封閉前確認開口已在容許範圍並記錄溫度，焊後以超音波檢測接縫並複測線形。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After each lift measure top and bottom gaps at every joint, segment levels and cable sag against the stage analysis; before welding confirm gaps are within tolerance and record temperature, then test the welds ultrasonically and re-survey the profile. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：架設手冊應列出每一階段允許焊接的接縫、臨時鉸接件的設計風速與檢查頻率，以及停工風速；焊接封閉的順序須由設計者依施工階段分析核准。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The erection manual should list which joints may be welded at each stage, the design wind speed and inspection frequency of temporary hinges, and the stop-work wind speed; the welding closure sequence must be approved by the designer from the stage analysis.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若在主纜尚未接近完工線形時就提早焊接，後續吊裝會在已焊接頭產生強迫彎矩，可能使焊道或腹板開裂；臨時鉸接件強度不足時，強風中的節段擺動可能使接頭損壞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Welding before the cable nears its final profile forces bending into finished joints during later lifts and can crack welds or webs; undersized temporary hinges can be damaged as segments swing in strong wind. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.titleEn: Box-girder lifting and temporary hinges: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「橋面節段臨時鉸接」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Temporary deck-segment hinges” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若在主纜尚未接近完工線形時就提早焊接，後續吊裝會在已焊接頭產生強迫彎矩，可能使焊道或腹板開裂；臨時鉸接件強度不足時，強風中的節段擺動可能使接頭損壞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Welding before the cable nears its final profile forces bending into finished joints during later lifts and can crack welds or webs; undersized temporary hinges can be damaged as segments swing in strong wind. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此節段之間通常先以頂部臨時鉸接，底部保持開口，讓節段隨主纜幾何自由轉動；待大部分節段就位、主纜接近完工線形，開口逐漸閉合後才焊接成連續梁。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼箱梁節段吊上去就立即焊接，可以縮短工期而不影響結構。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Welding each box segment as soon as it is lifted saves time without affecting the structure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「導流板效果與舒適度驗收」與「主纜除濕改造的氣密驗收」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Guide-vane performance and comfort acceptance" and "Airtightness acceptance of the cable dehumidification retrofit": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 導流板效果與舒適度驗收：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Guide-vane performance and comfort acceptance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「導流板減振驗證」如何影響大貝爾特東橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Guide-vane verification” governs force, deformation or durability in “Great Belt East Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 導流板是裝在箱梁下緣轉角附近的細長板，改變流經下緣的流線，延遲或打散規則的渦流脫落，降低豎向渦振的驅動力，而不需要增加質量或阻尼器。它的效果高度依賴位置、角度與與梁面的間隙，因此必須在風洞中比較多種配置，再以實橋監測確認。驗收的對象不是應力，而是用路人感受到的豎向加速度與長期疲勞循環數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「導流板減振驗證」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Guide vanes are slender plates mounted near the lower corners of the box that redirect flow past the bottom edge, delaying or breaking up regular vortex shedding and reducing the forcing of vertical vortex vibration without adding mass or dampers. Their effect depends strongly on position, angle and gap to the girder, so several configurations must be compared in the wind tunnel and then confirmed by monitoring on the bridge. Acceptance targets not stress but the vertical acceleration felt by road users and the long-term number of fatigue cycles. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Guide-vane verification” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：簡諧振動加速度 a = (2πf)²·A。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Harmonic acceleration a = (2πf)²·A.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「導流板只是外觀裝飾或擋雨板，拆掉不影響結構。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Guide vanes are cosmetic or rain shields and can be removed without structural effect." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「導流板減振驗證」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Guide-vane verification”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Their effect depends strongly on position, angle and gap to the girder, so several configurations must be compared in the wind tunnel and then confirmed by monitoring on the bridge.

quiz.question: 關於「導流板效果與舒適度驗收」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Guide-vane performance and comfort acceptance" is correct?
options: 導流板只是外觀裝飾或擋雨板，拆掉不影響結構。
導流板是裝在箱梁下緣轉角附近的細長板，改變流經下緣的流線，延遲或打散規則的渦流脫落，降低豎向渦振的驅動力，而不需要增加質量或阻尼器。

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 導流板效果與舒適度驗收：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Guide-vane performance and comfort acceptance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「導流板減振驗證」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Guide-vane verification” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：簡諧振動加速度 a = (2πf)²·A。若 f = 0.13 Hz、振幅 A = 0.30 m：a = (0.817)²×0.30 ≈ 0.20 m/s²（約 2% g）；若導流板把振幅降到 0.05 m，a ≈ 0.033 m/s²。Scruton 數 Sc = 2mδ/(ρD²)，m = 16,000 kg/m、δ = 0.031、D = 4 m 時 Sc ≈ 50。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Harmonic acceleration a = (2πf)²·A. With f = 0.13 Hz and amplitude A = 0.30 m: a = (0.817)²×0.30 ≈ 0.20 m/s² (about 2% g); if guide vanes cut the amplitude to 0.05 m, a ≈ 0.033 m/s². The Scruton number Sc = 2mδ/(ρD²) with m = 16,000 kg/m, δ = 0.031 and D = 4 m is about 50. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：風洞中以相同 Scruton 數比較有無導流板及不同間隙、角度的振幅—風速曲線；安裝後在跨中與四分點設置加速度計，統計每一風速區間的最大加速度與振動持續時間，並與舒適度準則和安裝前資料比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In the wind tunnel compare amplitude–wind speed curves with and without vanes and at different gaps and angles at the same Scruton number; after installation place accelerometers at mid-span and quarter points, compiling peak acceleration and vibration duration per wind-speed bin against comfort criteria and pre-installation data.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

With f = 0.13 Hz and amplitude A = 0.30 m: a = (0.817)²×0.30 ≈ 0.20 m/s² (about 2% g); if guide vanes cut the amplitude to 0.05 m, a ≈ 0.033 m/s². The Scruton number Sc = 2mδ/(ρD²) with m = 16,000 kg/m, δ = 0.031 and D = 4 m is about 50. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

quiz.question: 依「導流板效果與舒適度驗收」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Guide-vane performance and comfort acceptance", which statement holds?
options: 混凝土橋塔不會生鏽，延壽只需處理鋼主纜與鋼箱梁。

optionsEn: Concrete pylons cannot rust, so life extension only concerns the steel cables and box girder.

steps.title: 導流板效果與舒適度驗收：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Guide-vane performance and comfort acceptance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「導流板減振驗證」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Guide-vane verification” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 風洞中以相同 Scruton 數比較有無導流板及不同間隙、角度的振幅—風速曲線；安裝後在跨中與四分點設置加速度計，統計每一風速區間的最大加速度與振動持續時間，並與舒適度準則和安裝前資料比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In the wind tunnel compare amplitude–wind speed curves with and without vanes and at different gaps and angles at the same Scruton number; after installation place accelerometers at mid-span and quarter points, compiling peak acceleration and vibration duration per wind-speed bin against comfort criteria and pre-installation data. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：導流板應列為結構構件，納入定期檢查清單與竣工圖，標明位置、間隙與允差；任何拆除或修改必須事先取得風工程師核可，並在恢復後複核振動監測資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Treat guide vanes as structural components on the inspection checklist and as-built drawings, with position, gap and tolerance marked; any removal or modification needs prior approval from the wind engineer, and vibration monitoring data must be reviewed after reinstatement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：導流板若安裝位置偏差或支撐鬆脫，效果可能大幅下降甚至引發新的振動；長期腐蝕或被維修作業移除而未恢復，渦振會在數年後重新出現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Vanes installed out of position or with loose supports can lose much of their effect or even trigger new vibration; corrosion or removal during maintenance without reinstatement lets vortex vibration return years later. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 主纜除濕改造的氣密驗收：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Airtightness acceptance of the cable dehumidification retrofit: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「主纜除濕改造驗收」如何影響大貝爾特東橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dehumidification retrofit acceptance” governs force, deformation or durability in “Great Belt East Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 營運單位記載，東橋主纜除濕系統於 2014 年開始安裝、2015 年 9 月完成：主纜外層以 Cableguard 強化彈性體包覆，並在索夾周圍密封，使乾燥空氣能從進氣套筒沿纜內空隙流到排氣套筒。公開資料指出，通車約 15 年時主纜尚未發現鏽蝕，業主仍參考其他橋梁（例如福斯公路橋）的腐蝕教訓，選擇以除濕取代單純重新塗裝。改造成敗取決於包覆與索夾密封的氣密性，因此驗收以壓力與流量試驗為核心。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「主纜除濕改造驗收」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The operator records that the East Bridge cable dehumidification system was installed from 2014 and completed in September 2015: the cables were wrapped in Cableguard reinforced elastomer and sealed around the cable clamps so dry air can flow through the cable voids from inlet sleeves to exhaust sleeves. Public accounts note that no rust had been found after about 15 years in service, yet the owner, drawing on corrosion found on other bridges such as the Forth Road Bridge, chose dehumidification over repainting alone. Success depends on the airtightness of the wrapping and clamp seals, so acceptance centres on pressure and flow tests. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Dehumidification retrofit acceptance” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：主纜空隙面積 = 0.541 − 0.424 ≈ 0.117 m²，150 m 區段空隙體積約 17.6 m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Cable void area = 0.541 − 0.424 ≈ 0.117 m², so a 150 m section holds about 17.6 m³ of voids.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「主纜沒有生鏽就不需要除濕，等出現鏽蝕再處理比較經濟。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If a cable shows no rust there is no need to dehumidify; it is cheaper to wait for corrosion." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「主纜除濕改造驗收」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 主纜除濕改造的氣密驗收：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Airtightness acceptance of the cable dehumidification retrofit: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「主纜除濕改造驗收」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Dehumidification retrofit acceptance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：主纜空隙面積 = 0.541 − 0.424 ≈ 0.117 m²，150 m 區段空隙體積約 17.6 m³。壓力衰減試驗中若 10 分鐘內由 3,000 Pa 降到 2,000 Pa，洩漏量 Q ≈ (V/p_a)·Δp/Δt = (17.6/101,325)×1,000/600 ≈ 2.9×10⁻⁴ m³/s，約 17 L/min。允收門檻須事先約定。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Cable void area = 0.541 − 0.424 ≈ 0.117 m², so a 150 m section holds about 17.6 m³ of voids. If a pressure-decay test falls from 3,000 Pa to 2,000 Pa in 10 minutes, the leakage Q ≈ (V/p_a)·Δp/Δt = (17.6/101,325)×1,000/600 ≈ 2.9×10⁻⁴ m³/s, about 17 L/min. The acceptance threshold must be agreed in advance. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每一區段包覆完成後封閉進、排氣口做壓力衰減試驗，必要時以肥皂水或聲波檢漏定位洩漏點；系統啟動後記錄各排氣口的流量、溫度與相對濕度，直到排氣濕度穩定低於目標值，才算完成調試。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After each section is wrapped, close the inlet and exhaust and run a pressure-decay test, locating leaks with soapy water or acoustic detection where needed; after start-up log flow, temperature and relative humidity at every exhaust until exhaust humidity settles below target before commissioning is complete.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 主纜除濕改造的氣密驗收：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Airtightness acceptance of the cable dehumidification retrofit: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「主纜除濕改造驗收」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Dehumidification retrofit acceptance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每一區段包覆完成後封閉進、排氣口做壓力衰減試驗，必要時以肥皂水或聲波檢漏定位洩漏點；系統啟動後記錄各排氣口的流量、溫度與相對濕度，直到排氣濕度穩定低於目標值，才算完成調試。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After each section is wrapped, close the inlet and exhaust and run a pressure-decay test, locating leaks with soapy water or acoustic detection where needed; after start-up log flow, temperature and relative humidity at every exhaust until exhaust humidity settles below target before commissioning is complete. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：除濕改造合約應明定每區段的氣密試驗方法、允收洩漏量、包覆熔接的環境條件與見證程序，並把各區段的調試數據納入資產系統，作為日後偵測劣化的基準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The dehumidification contract should define the airtightness test per section, allowable leakage, environmental limits for wrap fusion and the witnessing procedure, and put each section's commissioning data into the asset system as the baseline for detecting later deterioration.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：索夾邊緣密封不良是最常見的洩漏點，乾燥空氣在第一個索夾就逸出，下游區段仍然潮濕；包覆搭接若在低溫時施作而熔合不足，日後溫度循環下會開裂進水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Poor seals at cable-clamp edges are the commonest leaks, letting dry air escape at the first clamp while downstream sections stay wet; wrapping laps fused at low temperature without full bonding can crack and admit water under later thermal cycling. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「主纜除濕改造驗收」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Dehumidification retrofit acceptance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 索夾邊緣密封不良是最常見的洩漏點，乾燥空氣在第一個索夾就逸出，下游區段仍然潮濕；包覆搭接若在低溫時施作而熔合不足，日後溫度循環下會開裂進水。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Poor seals at cable-clamp edges are the commonest leaks, letting dry air escape at the first clamp while downstream sections stay wet; wrapping laps fused at low temperature without full bonding can crack and admit water under later thermal cycling. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If a cable shows no rust there is no need to dehumidify; it is cheaper to wait for corrosion." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 營運期的船舶撞擊風險管理：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Managing ship-collision risk in operation: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「船舶監控與偏航風險」如何影響大貝爾特東橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ship monitoring and aberrancy risk” governs force, deformation or durability in “Great Belt East Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 設計時的撞擊機率假設會隨船隊、航速與航道使用改變，因此營運期的風險管理與結構本身同樣重要。營運單位設有船舶監控系統，確保大型船舶使用東航道；當船舶偏離航線時，監控中心可以警告、通知海軍或海巡，並在必要時封閉橋梁。1991 年芬蘭曾向國際法院主張 65 m 淨空會妨礙芬蘭建造的鑽探平台通過，此案於 1992 年和解撤回，顯示淨空與航道規則本身就是長期的營運約束。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「船舶監控與偏航風險」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Collision probabilities assumed at design change with the fleet, ship speeds and channel use, so risk management in operation matters as much as the structure. The operator runs a ship-monitoring system to keep large vessels in the East Channel; when a ship strays, the centre can warn it, alert the navy or coastguard and close the bridge if needed. In 1991 Finland told the International Court of Justice that the 65 m clearance would block drilling rigs built in Finland; the case was settled and withdrawn in 1992, showing that clearance and channel rules are themselves long-term operating constraints. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Ship monitoring and aberrancy risk” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：年撞擊頻率 F = N·P_A·P_G·P_F。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Annual collision frequency F = N·P_A·P_G·P_F.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「橋梁通車後，撞擊風險就固定不變，不需要再評估。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Managing ship-collision risk in operation" is correct?

steps.title: 營運期的船舶撞擊風險管理：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Managing ship-collision risk in operation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「船舶監控與偏航風險」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ship monitoring and aberrancy risk” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：年撞擊頻率 F = N·P_A·P_G·P_F。取 N = 23,750 艘/年、偏航機率 P_A = 1×10⁻⁴、幾何撞擊機率 P_G = 0.01、未能及時攔阻機率 P_F = 0.2：F ≈ 23,750×10⁻⁴×0.01×0.2 ≈ 4.75×10⁻³，回歸期約 210 年；監控若使 P_F 減半，回歸期約 420 年。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Annual collision frequency F = N·P_A·P_G·P_F. With N = 23,750 ships a year, aberrancy probability P_A = 1×10⁻⁴, geometric probability P_G = 0.01 and failure-to-intervene P_F = 0.2: F ≈ 23,750×10⁻⁴×0.01×0.2 ≈ 4.75×10⁻³, a return period of about 210 years; halving P_F by monitoring gives about 420 years. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：定期以船舶自動識別系統（AIS）資料更新船型、尺寸與航跡統計，重新計算各構件的撞擊頻率；演練偏航船舶的通報與封橋程序，記錄反應時間，並檢查防撞設施與錨碇外緣的損傷。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Periodically update ship type, size and track statistics from AIS data and recompute impact frequency for each element; drill the reporting and bridge-closure procedure for errant ships, recording response times, and inspect fenders and anchor-block edges for damage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「船舶監控與偏航風險」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 定期以船舶自動識別系統（AIS）資料更新船型、尺寸與航跡統計，重新計算各構件的撞擊頻率；演練偏航船舶的通報與封橋程序，記錄反應時間，並檢查防撞設施與錨碇外緣的損傷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Periodically update ship type, size and track statistics from AIS data and recompute impact frequency for each element; drill the reporting and bridge-closure procedure for errant ships, recording response times, and inspect fenders and anchor-block edges for damage. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：業主應把船舶撞擊風險評估列為定期更新的文件，訂出觸發重新評估的條件（例如設計船型以上船舶的通過次數增加），並與海事主管機關簽訂聯合應變程序與演練頻率。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The owner should treat the ship-collision risk assessment as a periodically updated document, define triggers for reassessment such as more transits by ships larger than the design vessel, and agree a joint response procedure and drill frequency with the maritime authority.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若船隊大型化而風險評估多年未更新，實際撞擊能量與頻率可能超出原設計假設；監控中心與海事單位的通報流程不清，則可能在偏航事件中錯失攔阻時間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the fleet grows larger while the risk assessment stays unrevised for years, actual impact energy and frequency may exceed design assumptions; unclear reporting between the monitoring centre and maritime agencies can lose the time needed to intercept an errant ship. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
