steps.title: 延壽評估與海洋環境混凝土：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Life-extension assessment and marine concrete: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「200 年使用年限評估」如何影響大貝爾特東橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “200-year service-life assessment” governs force, deformation or durability in “Great Belt East Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 營運單位公開說明，2020 年 Rambøll 的評估認為大貝爾特橋梁的使用年限可透過最佳化維護、數據與數位工具倍增到 200 年以上，僅計混凝土與鋼材即可避免約 750,000 t 的二氧化碳排放。延壽的關鍵不只是鋼構防蝕，也包括海中橋塔、錨碇與橋墩的混凝土：氯離子從海水滲入保護層，到達鋼筋位置並超過臨界濃度後，鋼筋才開始腐蝕。延壽評估要以實測氯離子剖面、保護層厚度與電化學量測，預測何時需要介入。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「200 年使用年限評估」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The operator states that a 2020 assessment by Rambøll found that the Great Belt bridge's service life could be doubled to more than 200 years through optimised maintenance, data and digital tools, avoiding about 750,000 t of CO2 for concrete and steel alone. Life extension depends not only on steel corrosion protection but also on the concrete of marine pylons, anchor blocks and piers: chlorides from seawater penetrate the cover, and reinforcement corrodes only after they reach the bar at more than a critical concentration. The assessment must use measured chloride profiles, cover thickness and electrochemical readings to predict when intervention will be needed. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “200-year service-life assessment” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 延壽評估與海洋環境混凝土：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Life-extension assessment and marine concrete: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「200 年使用年限評估」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “200-year service-life assessment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Fick 第二定律 C(x,t) = C_s·[1 − erf(x/(2√(D·t)))]。取 C_s = 0.6%（膠結材重）、D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s、保護層 x = 75 mm：100 年 2√(Dt) ≈ 0.112 m，C ≈ 0.6×0.345 ≈ 0.21%；200 年 2√(Dt) ≈ 0.159 m，C ≈ 0.6×0.504 ≈ 0.30%，仍低於假設門檻 0.4%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Fick's second law C(x,t) = C_s·[1 − erf(x/(2√(D·t)))]. With C_s = 0.6% by binder, D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s and cover x = 75 mm: at 100 years 2√(Dt) ≈ 0.112 m and C ≈ 0.6×0.345 ≈ 0.21%; at 200 years 2√(Dt) ≈ 0.159 m and C ≈ 0.6×0.504 ≈ 0.30%, still below an assumed 0.4% threshold. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在潮差區、浪濺區與水下區分別鑽取粉末或岩心，量測氯離子剖面並擬合擴散係數與表面濃度；以保護層測定儀抽查保護層厚度，配合半電池電位與電阻率量測，把預測時間與檢測結果寫入資產管理系統，逐年更新。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Drill powder samples or cores in the tidal, splash and submerged zones, measure chloride profiles and fit diffusion coefficient and surface concentration; survey cover with a covermeter alongside half-cell potential and resistivity readings, and enter predictions and results into the asset-management system for annual updating.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Fick's second law C(x,t) = C_s·[1 − erf(x/(2√(D·t)))]. With C_s = 0.6% by binder, D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s and cover x = 75 mm: at 100 years 2√(Dt) ≈ 0.112 m and C ≈ 0.6×0.345 ≈ 0.21%; at 200 years 2√(Dt) ≈ 0.159 m and C ≈ 0.6×0.504 ≈ 0.30%, still below an assumed 0.4% threshold. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 延壽評估與海洋環境混凝土：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Life-extension assessment and marine concrete: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「200 年使用年限評估」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “200-year service-life assessment” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在潮差區、浪濺區與水下區分別鑽取粉末或岩心，量測氯離子剖面並擬合擴散係數與表面濃度；以保護層測定儀抽查保護層厚度，配合半電池電位與電阻率量測，把預測時間與檢測結果寫入資產管理系統，逐年更新。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Drill powder samples or cores in the tidal, splash and submerged zones, measure chloride profiles and fit diffusion coefficient and surface concentration; survey cover with a covermeter alongside half-cell potential and resistivity readings, and enter predictions and results into the asset-management system for annual updating. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：延壽計畫應把每類構件的劣化模型、檢測頻率、介入門檻與資料格式寫成可審查的文件，並在每次大型檢測後更新預測；資產管理系統中的紀錄須能追溯到構件編號與檢測位置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The life-extension plan should set out deterioration models, inspection frequencies, intervention thresholds and data formats for each element type as a reviewable document, updating predictions after every major inspection; records in the asset system must trace to element numbers and test locations.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只以設計時的擴散係數預測而不實測，浪濺區的實際氯離子累積可能遠快於假設，鋼筋腐蝕膨脹造成保護層剝落；局部保護層不足的位置會比平均值早數十年出現劣化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Predicting from design diffusion coefficients without measurement can miss much faster chloride build-up in the splash zone, where corroding bars spall the cover; spots with thin cover deteriorate decades earlier than the average suggests. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 延壽評估與海洋環境混凝土：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Life-extension assessment and marine concrete: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「200 年使用年限評估」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “200-year service-life assessment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只以設計時的擴散係數預測而不實測，浪濺區的實際氯離子累積可能遠快於假設，鋼筋腐蝕膨脹造成保護層剝落；局部保護層不足的位置會比平均值早數十年出現劣化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Predicting from design diffusion coefficients without measurement can miss much faster chloride build-up in the splash zone, where corroding bars spall the cover; spots with thin cover deteriorate decades earlier than the average suggests. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：延壽評估要以實測氯離子剖面、保護層厚度與電化學量測，預測何時需要介入。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The assessment must use measured chloride profiles, cover thickness and electrochemical readings to predict when intervention will be needed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土橋塔不會生鏽，延壽只需處理鋼主纜與鋼箱梁。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Concrete pylons cannot rust, so life extension only concerns the steel cables and box girder." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
